answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46544 Country: Bangladesh Title: standing up for jamat while recite qadqamatissalah. is this mustahab? pls give reference from some old fatwa kitabs. Question: I live in Dhaka, Bangladesh. One of our masjids in our area is with shrine beside it, many bidats are happening here. One of those is to stand up while say qad qamatissalah. Other ulamas from different masjid protest about their activities but they want authentic reference and fatwa. Please, give me authentic information with reference of some old fatwa book and page so that we can show them with your fatwa. Answer ID: 46544 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1179/403/TL=9/1434) For details you should see the books: Jawahir al-Fiqh, Fatawa Rahimiah, Fatawa Mahmoodiah etc. You should also see the link for a detailed fatwa: http://www.darulifta-deoband.org/showuserview.do?function=answerView&all=ur&id=42661 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
